lines.beaver_en: Jisu, are you excited about today's game?
lines.learner: 응! 경기장에서 응원하는 게 제일 기대돼.
lines.en: Yes! I'm most excited about cheering at the stadium.
lines.roman: eung! gyeonggijangeseo eungwonhaneun ge jeil gidaedwae.

lines.beaver_en: You know which stadium we're going to, right?
lines.learner: 응, 시청 근처 축구장이야. 딱 한 시간 걸려.
lines.en: Yes, the soccer field near City Hall. It takes exactly an hour.
lines.roman: eung, sicheong geuncheo chukgujangiya. ttak han sigan geollyeo.

lines.beaver_en: Did you practice our cheering songs too?
lines.learner: 응, 어제 응원 영상 보면서 연습했어.
lines.en: Yes, I practiced while watching cheering videos yesterday.
lines.roman: eung, eoje eungwon yeongsang bomyeonseo yeonseupaesseo.

lines.beaver_en: Does cheering have an effect on the players?
lines.learner: 응, 응원을 받으면 선수들이 더 잘한대.
lines.en: Yes, they say players do better when they get support.
lines.roman: eung, eungwoneul badeumyeon seonsudeuri deo jalhandae.

lines.beaver_en: What about other sports? You like volleyball too.
lines.learner: 응, 배구도 좋고 골프도 가끔 봐.
lines.en: Yes, I like volleyball, and I sometimes watch golf too.
lines.roman: eung, baegudo joko golpeudo gakkeum bwa.

lines.beaver_en: In golf you have to cheer quietly, right?
lines.en: Right. In golf you just clap a little.

lines.beaver: 그럼 너는 요즘 직접 하는 운동 있어?
lines.beaver_en: So, do you play any sports yourself these days?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom neoneun yojeum jikjeop haneun undong isseo?
lines.learner: 응. 다음 달에 마라톤 참가 신청했어.
lines.en: Yes. I signed up to take part in a marathon next month.
lines.roman: eung. daeum dare maraton chamga sincheonghaesseo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, amazing! Is the schedule set?
lines.learner: 응, 십일월 첫째 주 일요일이야. 응원해 줘!
lines.en: Yes, the first Sunday of November. Cheer for me!
lines.roman: eung, sibirwol cheotjjae ju iryoiriya. eungwonhae jwo!

lines.beaver_en: Of course! I'll cheer like during the World Cup.
lines.learner: 고마워. 월드컵 때 응원은 정말 신났지.
lines.en: Thanks. Cheering during the World Cup was so exciting.
lines.roman: gomawo. woldeukeop ttae eungwoneun jeongmal sinnatji.

lines.beaver_en: Okay, let's head out now. We'll be late!
lines.en: Okay, let's cheer loudly at the soccer field!
